clips.title: The story
paras: In Goldshire, A Fishy Peril begins with reports of murlocs moving inland through the waterways. Remy "Two Times" asks travelers to alert Marshal Dughan, whose guards are already stretched thin.

Remy "Two Times" grows uneasy over a new threat while seeking business in Goldshire. Murlocs are creeping up the streams and into inland shallows, disrupting fishing and menacing innocent travelers. Remy fears the local guard is overlooking a danger that is still growing, so he asks passersby to carry word to the heart of the township.

Marshal Dughan hears the report in Goldshire but remains skeptical. He is charged with protecting the realm while royal forces are stretched thin elsewhere, and Riverpaw gnolls and Defias highwaymen already demand his attention. With no confirmed military intelligence, he will not divert his scarce men to pursue rumors of fish-men in the eastern streams.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Friend, there's a new threat in Elwynn Forest! Murlocs are swimming up the streams of eastern Elwynn, scaring away fish and attacking gentle folk!
I warned Marshal Dughan, but he's more worried about the gnolls and the bandits. He's not convinced that the murlocs are a danger.
Please, friend, speak to Dughan and persuade him to send more troops to the east!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Yes, I spoke with Remy. I respect him as a merchant, though all reports of Murlocs to the east have been sketchy at best.
Your concerns are noted, but unless I receive a military report of a murloc threat, we can't afford to send more troops east.
